embed_notes: Every game is ONE self-contained games/<name>.html file (LittleJS inlined). Iframe any file directly; index.html is an arcade launcher driven by a games.js manifest with search, categories, gamepad, saved high scores.
reskin_notes: Single-file JS with emoji/twemoji + procedural art and simple color constants; trivial to swap palette, emoji sprites, title text. Repo ships CLAUDE.md + templates/ for AI-assisted edits.
score_hook: Games are LittleJS; each keeps a score var and writes localStorage high scores via the arcade shell - patch one shared helper to postMessage score to parent.
notes: Highest-leverage find: 65 permissively licensed classic-arcade clones (Pac-Man, Space Invaders, Frogger, Breakout, Missile Command, Pinball...) from the LittleJS author, each a single HTML file with a ready arcade shell.

name: abagames/crisp-game-lib
games: 110 tiny arcade games in docs/ (aerialbar, arcfire, balance, balloon, bamboo, baroll, bblast, boarding, bombup, chargebeam, crossline, darkcave, descents, dinos, findastar, flipbomb, floater, foosan, froooog, gloop, golfme, graveler, grenadier, hyperlaser, jujump, jumpon, ladderdrop, laserfortress, lightdark, mirrorfloor, monjum, numberball, orbitman, pinclimb, ...) plus sibling repos crisp-game-lib-12-games (3*, MIT), crisp-game-lib-11-games (24*, MIT), crisp-game-lib-games (9*, MIT)

score_hook: Excellent: every game uses global `score`, addScore(n), and end() on game over - one lib-level patch to postMessage score on end() covers all 110+ games.
notes: Largest single MIT pool of one-button/arcade micro-games; uniform API makes a universal score hook trivial. Ideal for play-to-earn quick sessions.

name: abagames/111-one-button-games-in-2021

embed_notes: Same layout as crisp-game-lib: docs/<game>/ with main.js + index.html; mobile/touch friendly by design (one button).

name: js13kGames (GitHub org, 2,521 repos)
license: mixed: 499 MIT, 78 GPL-3.0, 26 Apache-2.0, 16 Unlicense, 12 AGPL, 1815 none
games: Every entry 2014-2025 mirrored as js13kGames/<slug> (per year: 2014:129, 2015:158, 2016:126, 2017:246, 2018:262, 2019:199, 2020:219, 2021:217, 2022:397, 2023:163, 2024:187, 2025:199). Top-starred org copies: q1k3 56, 13th-floor 44 (MIT, 2024 #1), king-thirteen 34, coup-ahoo 31 (2024 #2), path-to-glory 23 (2023 #1), dr1v3n-wild 22 (2024 #8), clawstrike 16 (2025 #1), tiny-yurts 13 (MIT), ghosted 11, cat-survivors 11. Notable NO-LICENSE author repos: remvst/ninja 390* (2020 #1), agar3s/devil-glitches 208* (2016 #1), remvst/knight 154* (2023 #1), eliasku/13 100*, jani-nykanen/dying-dreams 95*, Auroriax/js13k-2020 80* (Edge Not Found)
embed_notes: Each org repo = the submitted 13KB zip contents (index.html at root, everything inlined) - the most iframe-friendly games on GitHub. BULK PULL: `gh repo list js13kGames --limit 3000 --json name,licenseInfo,stargazerCount > all.json`, filter licenseInfo.key==mit, then `gh repo clone js13kGames/<name> -- --depth 1` in a loop. Full listing already saved at research/coll/js13k_org.tsv.
reskin_notes: Minified/inlined 13KB builds are hard to edit; use the AUTHOR repos (linked in each org README) for readable source. Art is procedural or tiny sprite sheets.
score_hook: No standard; most games expose a score var and a game-over routine - patch per game, or wrap iframe + read DOM.
notes: ~500 MIT-licensed, tiny, mobile-friendly arcade games in one org; plus js13kGames/games (below) for pre-built copies.
